Question B-005-002-002. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: Glass, air, and porcelain are common insulating materials.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: Carbon can conduct enough to make the group unsuitable as three good insulators.
- sourceIndex 2: Aluminum is a good conductor, so the group cannot be three insulators.
- sourceIndex 3: Copper is a good conductor, so the group cannot be three insulators.
